main_topics.reason: The user asked whether the reduction in migraine days on Emgality counted as working and returned to how to interpret the improvement.
The user described logging migraine days in an app and engaged with advice to track severity and acute medication response too.
The user reported that their remaining migraines had become less severe and recognized this as another improvement.
The user worried their neurologist might stop treatment for not reaching a 50% reduction and asked what to raise at follow-up.

output.summary: After three months on Emgality, the user reported migraine days falling from about 20 to 15 and asked whether that meant it was working. The assistant framed this as a partial improvement, discussed evaluating progress through six months and tracking severity, and suggested topics for the neurologist; the user said they felt better and saw the treatment as working, though not finished.
